title: MiniBoardX
description: A mini board for your MC servers like score board with a few contents and nice animation.
body:
## MiniBoardX

MiniBoardX is a compact, modern, animated scoreboard plugin built for Minecraft servers that want a clean sidebar without giant, messy layouts. It is designed to stay small, readable, and easy to customize while still showing important server and player information like rank, health, level, ping, online players, and server website.

MiniBoardX includes a built-in web browser editor, so server owners can edit the scoreboard without manually touching YAML files. The panel lets you customize titles, lines, colors, animations, presets, placeholders, and settings from your browser.

Features

- Compact animated scoreboard
- Clean green/yellow default theme
- Built-in web editor
- Live scoreboard preview
- Visual line editor
- Raw YAML editor
- Scoreboard presets/themes
- PlaceholderAPI support
- LuckPerms/Vault rank support
- Built-in fallback placeholders
- Player toggle system
- Database support
- Config backup system
- Compact line-length protection
- Debug/status commands
- Designed for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia-compatible servers
- Java 17+ compatible

Built-in Web Editor

MiniBoardX comes with a web panel for easier scoreboard editing.

Default web panel:

http://SERVER-IP:6756

Default bind:

0.0.0.0:6756

Default login:

Username: admin
Password: 123456

The web editor includes:

- Dashboard
- Visual scoreboard editor
- Live preview
- Preset/theme manager
- Raw config editor
- Player preferences
- Database status
- Backup manager
- Compatibility/status page

Important: The default web panel binds to "0.0.0.0", which means it may be reachable from other devices on your network. Change the default password before exposing the server publicly.

Default Scoreboard

The default layout is designed to be small and clean:

- Player name
- Rank
- Health
- Level
- Ping
- Online players
- Website/footer

Normal players show as "Player" by default. Operators show as "OP". If LuckPerms or Vault is installed, MiniBoardX can use your actual rank/group system.

Commands

Main command:

/miniboardx

Aliases:

/mbx
/miniboard
/boardx

Available commands:

/mbx help
/mbx reload
/mbx toggle
/mbx on
/mbx off
/mbx preview
/mbx debug
/mbx debug <player>
/mbx status
/mbx web
/mbx web url
/mbx web start
/mbx web stop
/mbx web restart
/mbx version
/mbx database status
/mbx backup create

Permissions

miniboardx.use
miniboardx.toggle
miniboardx.preview
miniboardx.admin
miniboardx.reload
miniboardx.debug
miniboardx.web
miniboardx.status
miniboardx.database
miniboardx.backup
miniboardx.bypass

Built-in Placeholders

MiniBoardX includes built-in placeholders, so it can work even without PlaceholderAPI:

%player_name%
%player_displayname%
%player_uuid%
%rank%
%health%
%max_health%
%level%
%exp%
%ping%
%world%
%gamemode%
%online%
%max_players%
%server_name%
%server_version%
%java_version%
%platform%
%date%
%time%
%x%
%y%
%z%

PlaceholderAPI is supported for extra placeholders if installed.

Compatibility

MiniBoardX is built using stable Bukkit APIs and Java 17 bytecode to support the widest practical range of Bukkit-compatible servers that can run Java 17 or newer.

Supported server types include:

- Bukkit
- Spigot
- Paper
- Purpur
- Folia-compatible servers

MiniBoardX does not require NMS, CraftBukkit internals, or ProtocolLib.

Installation

1. Download the MiniBoardX jar.
2. Put it inside your server’s "plugins" folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Open the web editor at:

http://SERVER-IP:6756

5. Login with:

admin / 123456

6. Change the password after first login.
7. Customize your scoreboard from the web panel or config.

Why MiniBoardX?

Most scoreboard plugins can become too large, too cluttered, or annoying to configure. MiniBoardX focuses on keeping the scoreboard compact, polished, animated, and easy to edit from a browser.

If you want a clean sidebar with modern customization, MiniBoardX is built for that.
